name: Starship XO
source:
Fresh out of the academy, your homeland of Alcase is forced into war. Join Alex and their new crew on a queer space adventure! Get the ending with the bae of your choice!

[From [url=https://newwestgames.itch.io/starship-xo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
刚从学院毕业，你的祖国阿尔卡斯就被迫陷入战争。与亚历克斯和他们的新船员一起踏上酷儿太空冒险！以你选择的宝贝获得结局！

[来自[url=https://newwestgames.itch.io/starship-xo]Itch.io[/url]]
